extracted.name: No-Peek Beef Stew
extracted.description: This no-peek beef stew is made in a slow cooker with condensed soup, mushrooms, and red wine for a delicious meal to come home to after a busy day.
ingredient_lines: 2 pounds beef stew meat, cut into 1 inch cubes
1 (10.5 ounce) can condensed French onion soup
1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
instruction_lines: Place beef stew meat, condensed French onion soup, condensed cream of mushroom soup, mushrooms, and dry red wine into a slow cooker. Cover and cook on Low for 8 hours.
